$description: Semantic layer for the dark theme — the only theme NoPlace ships today. Feature code reads *these* names; if a screen needs a colour that is not here, add a semantic token instead of reaching into the palette.

canvas.$description: Behind everything, including the map when tiles have not loaded.

panelRaised.$description: Sheets and anything floating above the map.

fog.$description: Unexplored ground. Opaque: with no basemap beneath, a translucent fog would only reveal more of the same black.

exploredGround.$description: Ground the player has uncovered. Without a basemap this colour *is* the reward, so it has to read clearly against the fog.

subtle.$description: 16% ember — selected chips, active tab background.

glow.$description: 70% ember — the halo around the player dot.

unknown.$description: A site the player has not identified yet.

map.$description: The basemap, drawn on ground the player has already uncovered. Every value here is deliberately close to background.exploredGround: the map is orientation, not decoration, and the orange pins must stay the loudest thing on screen.

earth.$description: Land. The same colour as uncovered ground, so the basemap appears to *be* the ground rather than sit on it.

water.$description: Rivers and the sea. Blue enough to read as water at a glance, dark enough not to glow.

park.$description: Parks and greenery. A hint of moss, well below the saturation of category.park.

landuse.$description: Built-up and institutional areas — a barely-there lift off earth.

building.$description: Building footprints. Visible at walking zoom, invisible at city zoom.

roadMinor.$description: Residential streets and service roads — most of what a walker actually uses.

roadMajor.$description: Arterials. The lines that let you recognise a district from its shape.

roadHighway.$description: Motorways and trunk roads, the brightest geometry on the map.

boundary.$description: District edges, drawn with the rest of the map and therefore hidden by the fog.

cityBorder.$description: 35% ember — the edge of the city, drawn *above* the fog. It is the one line that shows what has not been explored yet, so it has to read against unexplored black without competing with a pin.

label.$description: Street and place names. Muted on purpose: legible when looked for, never competing with a pin.

labelHalo.$description: 80% canvas, painted behind label text so it stays readable over roads and water alike.
